versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 of work-style-memory

- No file changes detected; documentation content remains unchanged.
- No new features, bug fixes, or enhancements in this release.

- Initial release of the work-style-memory skill.
- Adds local workflow library for user-defined SOPs, workflows, and multi-step processes.
- Proactively matches and suggests reuse of existing workflows before starting non-trivial tasks.
- Offers to save or update workflows based on user preferences and observed process patterns.
- Includes UI and script support for editing, matching, and capturing workflows in JSON format.
